invariant: i ≤ arr.size ∧ (pos = -1 ∨ (0 ≤ pos ∧ pos.toNat < i ∧ arr[pos.toNat]! = elem)) ∧ (pos = -1 → ∀ k, k < i → arr[k]! ≠ elem) ∧ (0 ≤ pos → ∀ k, pos.toNat < k → k < i → arr[k]! ≠ elem)

children.expr: (i + 1, if arr[i]! = elem then (i : Int) else pos)

lemmas.name: exit46
lemmas.statement: ∀ (arr : Array Int) (elem : Int) (i : Nat) (pos : Int) (h : lastPosition_precond arr elem), (i ≤ arr.size ∧ (pos = -1 ∨ (0 ≤ pos ∧ pos.toNat < i ∧ arr[pos.toNat]! = elem)) ∧ (pos = -1 → ∀ k, k < i → arr[k]! ≠ elem) ∧ (0 ≤ pos → ∀ k, pos.toNat < k → k < i → arr[k]! ≠ elem)) → ¬ i < arr.size → lastPosition_postcond arr elem pos h
lemmas.proof:
by intro arr elem i pos h hinv hn
  obtain ⟨hi, hp, h1, h2⟩ := hinv
  have hi' : i = arr.size := by omega
  subst hi'
  unfold lastPosition_postcond
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rcases hp with hp | hp
    · left; exact hp
    · right; omega
  · intro hge
    rcases hp with hp | ⟨_, hb, he⟩
    · omega
    · refine ⟨hb, he, ?_⟩
      simp only [List.all_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
      rw [Refine.forall_mem_drop_iff]
      intro k hk1 hk2
      have hk2' : k < arr.size := by simpa using hk2
      rw [Refine.toList_getElem_bang arr k hk2']
      exact h2 (by omega) k (by omega) hk2'
  · intro hneg
    simp only [List.all_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
    rw [Refine.forall_mem_toList_iff_idx]
    intro k hk
    exact h1 hneg k hk
